verdict.rationale: A consent-management surface is a fair question for a financial data aggregator like MX, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents end users connecting accounts (Connect Widget) and an operator-side Client Dashboard User lookup of connection attempts. Nothing shows an end-user portal for viewing or revoking which apps hold access to their bank data.

support.subject: As an ops lead, end users can see and revoke what they've shared — a documented consent surface or portal where a user manages which apps hold access to their bank data
